journal.myfirstmod.exploration:
THE THRESHOLD

The lit causeway leads to the arena. The gate behind you leads home.

Sneak-use your compass to select arena, sanctuary, or a known ready court.
journal.myfirstmod.trials:
RESONANCE COURTS

Use a core to enroll nearby allies. Late arrivals get no rewards.

After the boss, sneak-use a core to attempt your next tier. Five tiers await. Leaving for 30s ends a trial.
journal.myfirstmod.oaths:
COURT OATHS

Fracture: dodge fixed fire circles.

Siphon: sneak at both ward circles to stop enemy healing.

Pursuit: hunters move faster. Final waves have a captain.
journal.myfirstmod.warden:
THE NULL WARDEN

Attacks commit to marked locations. Dodge the marks, then strike in recovery.

Sneak near a glowing pylon to cleanse it. Its inner pocket grounds pylon pulses, NOT boss attacks.
journal.myfirstmod.equipment:
RELICS

Hold then release the Nullblade to rend. Sneak-use to step safely forward.

Use the Heart for healing and slow falling.

Smith your blade with a Matrix and echo shard to awaken it.
journal.myfirstmod.endgame:
THE ECHO RITUAL

Offer an Echo Sigil at 8, 81, 30 after victory. Tier 2+ courts and vaults grant sigils.

Rematches award crests. Craft a crest, shield, and Matrix into the projectile-deflecting Rift Aegis.

message.myfirstmod.first_relics: First victory: the Nullblade and Heart of the Null are yours.

journal.myfirstmod.resources:
THE LIVING REALM

Mine Nullstone below Y=65 for Resonite, Prism Dust, and Cinder Pearls. Iron-tier tools or better are needed.

Smelt Resonite. Harvest Hush Leaves for fiber and food.
journal.myfirstmod.wilds_gear:
EXPEDITION GEAR

The Prism Staff spends dust for precise ranged attacks.

Grounded maul slams push enemies away.

Hold damaged mod gear in your other hand to use a Repair Kit.
journal.myfirstmod.waystones:
WAYSTONES

Bind at a shrine. Channel a Wayfarer Thread for 3s to recall; sneak for sanctuary. Damage interrupts.

No recall from boss fights or enrolled trials. Cooldown: 60s.

journal.myfirstmod.convergence:
CONVERGENCE
Rifts closed: %s
Find ruined observatories in new realm chunks. Use the central anchor in Survival. Nearby allies join. Sneak on each glowing seal for 3s, then defeat the Herald. Dodge marked bursts; its ring is safe inside 3 blocks or beyond 6.
journal.myfirstmod.attunement:
ATTUNEMENT
Rifts award Astral Cores. Craft a rune with a core, shard, and golden apple (Vigor), feather (Gale), or prism dust (Focus). At a forge, hold your relic main-hand and rune offhand. Sneak to replace. One rune per relic; shared effect cooldowns.
journal.myfirstmod.cultivation:
CULTIVATION
Craft two Hush Nurseries with two hushberries, dusk fiber, and lumen moss. Plant on dirt, moss, grass, or farmland. They grow in realm darkness; elsewhere provide light. Bonemeal speeds growth. Use mature plants for berries and fiber without uprooting.
item.myfirstmod.astral_core.tooltip: Close Convergence rifts to earn cores. Craft with a shard and an attunement ingredient.

item.myfirstmod.gale_rune.tooltip: Forge into a relic: casts grant Speed I for 4s. Shared 10s cooldown.

journal.myfirstmod.pilgrimage:
ASHEN PILGRIMAGE

The kingdom buried its names beneath its churches. Seek their embers, rest at waystones, and return stronger.

New cathedrals rise beyond explored lands. Your first flask and Step are gifts; replacements can be crafted.
journal.myfirstmod.flask:
THE LAST FLAME

Charges: %s / %s

Hold use for 1.6s to heal four hearts. Damage interrupts.

Sneak-use near a safe waystone for 5s to restore health and charges. Keep a Mourning Ember offhand to add a charge, up to five.
journal.myfirstmod.cathedral:
MOURNING CATHEDRALS

Reliquaries opened: %s

Enter beneath the tall vault. Descend the west stair to the crypt, then the east stair to the ossuary.

Break or suppress the spawners. The lowest chamber holds the sealed reward.
journal.myfirstmod.funeral:
THE FUNERARY RITE

First: the drowned, in the middle crypt.
Second: the crowned, in the upper nave.
Last: the nameless, in the lowest ossuary.

Use their seals in order. Mistakes reset the rite. Return to the lowest reliquary when all three glow.
journal.myfirstmod.combat:
STEEL AND SILENCE

Knights commit to a cleave. Circle behind or land a heavy hit during the tell to stagger them.

Hunters mark a lunge; leave the mark.

Use Pilgrim’s Step to evade; sneak to backstep. The Warden takes 20% more melee damage in recovery.

item.myfirstmod.pilgrim_atlas.tooltip: Use in the realm: survey loaded chunk centers and route to the nearest known landmark. Sneak-use cycles five categories. Never generates chunks.

item.myfirstmod.silent_vow.tooltip: Use near a safe waystone to renounce your vow. Consumed on change; 60s shared vow cooldown.

journal.myfirstmod.remembrance:
REMEMBRANCE

Memorials: %s
Contracts claimed: %s / 7
Vow: %s

Find bell towers, shelters, and grave gardens in new terrain. Use their stele once per player to recover a Memory Shard and a story.
journal.myfirstmod.vows:
VOWS

Craft two Memory Shards with an ingot (Iron), cinder pearl (Embers), or dusk fiber (Mist). Use near a safe waystone.

One vow, with a benefit and a burden. Silence clears it. Changes take 60s to recover. Effects linger up to 3s on leaving.
journal.myfirstmod.atlas:
PILGRIM ATLAS

Craft a compass, book, and prism dust. Use to survey the centers of loaded chunks nearby. Sneak-use cycles waystone, court, rift, cathedral, and unread memorial.

Remembers 128 sites. Old, unloaded markers may be stale.
journal.myfirstmod.ledger:
PILGRIM LEDGER

At the sanctuary or a crafted ledger, use without shards to claim eligible milestone contracts. Each pays once per player.

Sneak-use cycles supply offers. Hold Memory Shards main-hand and use to buy. Realm only.
memory.myfirstmod.0: The bell was not built to call the faithful. It warned the living when the city forgot a name.
memory.myfirstmod.1: The pilgrim left a full flask beneath this roof. No one remembers whether they ever returned.
memory.myfirstmod.2: Iron endured the siege. Embers fed the survivors. Mist carried their children beyond the walls.
memory.myfirstmod.3: The archivists sealed the crowned above the drowned, but left a place below for those without names.
memory.myfirstmod.4: They called the guardian cruel until the first star fell through the broken observatory.
memory.myfirstmod.5: Not every light in the fen is a soul. Some are promises that no one has yet broken.
journal.myfirstmod.gate:
THE VOID GATE

Eight polished deepslate around an echo shard makes four frame blocks.

Build a 4-wide, 5-tall reinforced-deepslate frame along positive X. Leave its 2x3 interior empty. Ignite bottom-left, near a sculk catalyst.
item.myfirstmod.regent_crest.tooltip: Trophy of the Hollow Keep. Craft diagonally with a Resonite Ingot and stick for a Requiem Glaive.
item.myfirstmod.requiem_glaive.tooltip: Hold use for at least 1s, then release: six-block reaping arc, 14 damage, Slowness II. A successful hit grants 2 temporary hearts. 7s cooldown. Supports forge attunement.

journal.myfirstmod.keep:
THE HOLLOW KEEP

Clears claimed: %s

After the Warden falls, use the gate at -6, 81, 158. Gather within 16 blocks of the Expedition Heart to enroll. Break west, east, and north wards, then face the Regent in the great hall.
journal.myfirstmod.regent:
THE GRAVE REGENT

Dodge the cleave, funeral ring, and marked cross. Below half health it attacks faster and harder.

Flasks, armor bonuses, and vows work in the Keep. Rest is blocked during a run. Return through the gate to claim rewards; your first clear grants a glaive.
